description: Normative machine-readable evidence vocabulary for the seven UAP lineages (spec section 3.2): 14 shared evidence-observation claims + 20 lineage-specific claims with allowed emitters. Array order is the normative claim numbering (#1-#14 shared, #1-#20 specific within each lineage block). Structural contradiction pairs are listed here; claim-classification inconsistency rules and defense resolutions live in refutation_rules.json. Audit note: the spec §3.2 per-lineage count line reads 'l1: ... = 8', but the normative allowed-emitters table gives l1 exactly four shared claims (#1, #2, #3, #6); this file follows the normative table, and 4 >= 3 satisfies the claim contract.

shared_claims.description: Object appears as an unresolved point of light.
Object emits or reflects significant light.
Observed pattern shows temporal consistency over the analysis window (metadata timestamps, motion patterns, or audio patterns).
Motion characteristics show an identifiable velocity profile (motion dynamics or Doppler-like audio shifts).
Distinctive frequency-domain signature detected (spectral analysis or audio spectrogram).

specific_claims.description: Luminance profile matches patterns of known object classes.
Luminance gradient does not match common materials.
Object luminance ratio is high relative to scene.
Distinct spectral peak detected in frequency analysis.
Spectral entropy deviates from expected natural-scene distribution.
Harmonic frequency pattern detected.
Object contour matches known geometric templates.
Perspective cues are consistent with an estimated range.
Quantitative shape symmetry detected.
EXIF identifies the capture device.
File and EXIF timestamps are mutually consistent.
File container structure shows an anomaly (stripped EXIF, rewritten container).
Motion fits a ballistic trajectory under physical constraints.
Object holds position (hover) against wind/physics expectations.
Steady, powered, level trajectory detected.
CNN classifier confidence exceeds the taxonomy mapping threshold.
CNN feature pattern matched a mapped ImageNet class cluster.
Audio spectrogram shows a distinctive spectral signature.
Periodic rotor-like oscillation detected in audio.
Audio matches environmental (traffic, machinery, nature) profiles.

structural_contradictions.reason: object cannot be both unresolved and spatially extended
object cannot have both sharp and diffuse edges
object cannot be both symmetric and asymmetric
